mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 6-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6.5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressure and profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 6.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).
